text: Hello, mujhe ek issue report karna tha. Maine ek crockery set order kiya tha, Rs 2,199 ka, aur delivery person ne mujhe ek aisi box di jo visibly crushed thi. Box ke andar se mujhe broken pieces ki आवाज़ bhi aa rahi thi. Maine opening se pehle photos bhi click karke rakh liye hain. Please check karke bataiye ki iska kya status hai, kyunki ye carrier-damaged goods hain.
